title: One control stick down. A whole mech cockpit to go.
author: Few-Refrigerator5014
selftext:
This is the first piece of HEAVENBREAK, my first-person mech game.

Built with Astra in Codex, going from reference to Blender to Unreal Engine 5. Plenty of back and forth getting the rubber, metal and buttons looking right, then catching all the little geometry issues in close-ups. Really happy with where this landed. I was genuinely impressed by how well Astra can follow instructions compared to just even Sol, truly a generational leap. Now to build the cockpit around it. 

More models coming soon.
